no.gendered_line: I never made it there and can't imagine I ever will.  Every time I've tried I've been headed off by the <zombies>.

dynamic_line.yes: The shelter's in your hands, at this point.

responses.text: Could you tell me that story again?
I could go check out that shelter for you if you like.  Bring back any supplies you left behind?
responses.//: Checks to see if you have already finished this quest (by extension, it applies to any future NPC with this background), whether you have read their notes from TALK_PREPPER_1_COMPUTER, and whether you have already asked them about this quest. The conditional checks here look a little crazy but they simply gate you out of this conversation for various reasons.

effect.u_message: <npc_name> marks the location of the LMOE shelter on your map.

responses.text: I know this might seem weird but… your shelter wasn't on the way out of town, was it?  A hole in the ground, surrounded by trees?  Full of supplies with a sign out front that says 'I'm gonna shoot you'?

dynamic_line.gendered_line: The shelter?  Bought the land pretty cheap.  I hired a contractor to build the thing but did the door myself.  Metal pin in the door frame.  Can't open unless you remove it.  There's a little pulley inside you have to pull up to reset.  They made dozens of these in the area, and I couldn't sleep knowing just any <name_b> at that company could waltz in as soon as shit hit the fan.  They'd know exactly where to go and what to do!  Nah… how do you think I've made it this long?  Always keep a trick up your sleeve.

responses.text: A contractor?  How much does something like a survivalist shelter cost?
But we're good to go, right?  I mean… the door is the only trick you had?  No clever traps hidden in the walls or anything?
You wouldn't keep ALL your tricks and secrets from me, though, would you?  After everything we've been through?
responses.//: Even though material possessions have been made trivially easy to obtain in the apocalypse, the prepper still values their stash, hence the difficult trial here.

responses.text: That's all I wanted to know.
